articles.title: OpenAI Found 948 Linux Security Flaws—And Figured Out How to Exploit Them
articles.snippet: An automated OpenAI system produced working exploits and draft fixes at roughly $1,279 per flaw, raising new questions about how cheaply AI can find holes in critical software at scale.

articles.title: Why Bitcoin's Next Soft Fork Could Feel Like a Practice Run
articles.snippet: Matt Corallo explains why patching four legacy bugs is about rebuilding muscle memory, just as much as it’s about Bitcoin maintenance.
